results.title: Advanced Deep Learning Approaches for Hate Speech Detection
results.content: # Advanced Deep Learning Approaches for Hate Speech Detection. In order to improve the screening efficiency of information containing hate speech, deep learning is applied in this field. Therefore, we give an overview of the deep learning applied in hate speech, introducing new ideas for solving this task in recent years, and propose potential problems in the task and analyze it.
